✈️ COMES OUT APRIL 14!

The new documentary #SKYKING : Panic in the Sky revisits the story of Richard “Beebo” Russell, the airport worker who stole a plane in Seattle and turned it into one of the most surreal aviation incidents in recent memory.

If you remember the air traffic control audio from that day, you already know why this case stayed with people — it didn’t feel like a typical true crime story. 

The documentary goes deeper into who he was, what happened, and why this story still feels so difficult to fully explain. It is a tear jerker, to say the least. Absolutely stunning.

Will you be watching when it comes out on April 14?

Watch on @hulu and @disneyplus ⭐ 

@abcnewsstudios @fifthseason @p.e.gillespie
